title: Payments (Payme / Click / Uzum / Paynet / inPAY) with invoices, a state machine and wallets

provider.description: Payment provider to add: payme (Payme Business Merchant API), click (Click SHOP API), uzum (Uzum Bank Merchant API), paynet (Paynet JSON-RPC) or inpay (inPAY aggregator)

mode.description: wallet = user balances topped up by payments (default on the first run), order = pay your own PaymentTarget (orders...), both. Modes add up across runs

force.description: Overwrite generated files that you have edited

root.description: Project directory relative to the current directory
